capability 2026-10-11 (session 13): adjust_volume execution-layer fix. The tool was in the catalogue (PlannerPromptBuilder.ACTION_CATALOG), registered (TOOL_ADJUST_VOLUME), validated (ToolRegistry), parsed (TaskPlanParser) and fast-pathed (HybridStepExecutor) - but AndroidDeviceAutomation.execute had NO AdjustVolume branch, so every planned volume change hit the final else and returned method=UNKNOWN. It could never run. Now resolved before the a11y-service gate (audio is AudioManager-backed, not tree-backed, exactly like ReadNotifications): invalid stream -> INVALID_STREAM, no controller -> AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE, else AudioController.adjust(...).
